_comment: Paste these mcpServers entries into your Claude Desktop or Claude Code config to expose HoloFlow tools as native MCP. For Claude Desktop: C:\Users\dimon\AppData\Roaming\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (MSIX location varies — use the one already in memory). For Claude Code: .claude/mcp_servers.json in your project root.

holoflow-stdio._comment: stdio transport — Claude Desktop spawns this process. Use this for Claude Desktop and Claude Code.

holoflow-http._comment: HTTP transport — already-running server. Use if you launched via start-all.bat. Faster startup, persistent state.
